concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished pixel-art boss health-bar concept presentation for the sewer action game Drain Damage. Wide landscape image. Dark desaturated teal sewer-brick backdrop, restrained so UI reads clearly. Main subject a long horizontal health bar spanning 85% of image width, with ornate but functional cockroach-themed framing. Put exact boss name "SKITTERLING" centered above it in readable pale warm ivory game lettering. Main bar at 65% health, sharp unambiguous left-to-right fill endpoint. Below it show two smaller matching examples labeled "FULL" and "LOW", showing 100% and 15% health, respectively. Consistent design in all three examples. Frame and decoration stay outside the inner health strip. Hand-crafted high-detail pixel art matching richly shaded 2D sewer game sprites; crisp pixel clusters, strong readability at game scale. This is a design proposal sheet, not a screenshot or implemented interface. No logos, no extra text except title and FULL/LOW and concept label.  Concept label: "1. CARAPACE". Design: Overlapping glossy cockroach wing cases form an articulated chitin frame with legs clutching its underside and long antennae at both ends. Inner health reservoir glows sickly chartreuse; drained portion is dark hollow segmented shell.
